summary: OBOOK Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: OWLS) filed a Form 6-K on July 23, 2026, containing a press release titled 'OwlTing Group Reports OwlPay Harbor Payment Volume Grew More Than 5x in Q2 2026, Reaching a Record High in July.' The filing reports unaudited operational metrics: OwlPay Harbor payment volume grew fivefold quarter-over-quarter, cumulative processed payment volume exceeded US$600 million as of June 30, 2026, and enterprise clients reached 67. The company notes growth in its digital currency-based cross-border payment platform. There are no deal terms, price, premium, or board actions. This is a routine operational update, not a special situation.
